verdict.rationale: The only first-party update guidance is for Antigravity: "Reinstall with the same command to update" (gh-8). That is an explicit update path, but it is a re-run of the install, not a dedicated update command. Marketplace distribution is documented for Claude Code and Antigravity (docs-51, docs-36, docs-74), yet nothing says those channels auto-update. Missing for 10: documented marketplace auto-update behavior, a dedicated update command, update instructions for the other supported harnesses (Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.), and independent confirmation that updating works.
